candidates.review_note: Choose the smaller matrix dimension for the pair of rectangle boundaries. Accumulate column sums for each row strip, and count equal prefix-sum residues modulo k in that strip. Every equal-residue prefix pair corresponds to exactly one nonempty rectangle with sum divisible by k, including single cells and the entire matrix. Dictionary residue counts avoid allocating storage proportional to a possibly large modulus; integer totals avoid overflow.

Each criticism maps heights l..floor((l+r)/2) to l-1 and the rest to r+1; odd r-l makes these nearest endpoints unique. An ordered treap holds current height groups and supports range isolation. Disjoint-set representatives bind individual buildings to groups, so merging a whole range never requires revisiting every building. Individual reassignment installs a fresh handle and cannot be affected by later merges of its former group. Every collapsed treap node is removed, giving amortized work proportional to initial groups plus created groups, with logarithmic ordered operations and path-compressed union by size.
